Biddable Spend
Weekly spend across Programmatic, Paid Social, and Paid Search. Current reporting scope: Postpaid + Broadband.

Programmatic | Source: pbi_programmatic_browsers_currentyr
Universe: Amazon DSP, Blis, DV360, The Trade Desk; multiple accounts, Channels and Buy Types.
Selected: Postpaid + HSI/Broadband. All qualifying DSPs/accounts/channels remain included.

Paid Social | Source: media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
Universe: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Twitter, LinkedIn, Indirect, Nextdoor, General MFC and other Paid Social values across multiple agencies/LOBs.
Selected: Paid Social + Agency = InHouse + Postpaid/Broadband.
Current qualifying platforms: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Twitter.
No platform whitelist is used; qualifying future platforms can flow through automatically.

Paid Search | Source: sdi_tbl_sa360_gold_campaign_daily
Universe: Google/Bing accounts; SEARCH, SHOPPING, PERFORMANCE_MAX, DISCOVERY; Brand, Generic, Shopping, PMax, DemandGen; Postpaid, HSI, Metro, TFB, Fiber.
Selected: Google + Bing, Postpaid + HSI/Broadband + Fiber. All qualifying accounts and campaign/channel types remain included.

Total definition: All Channels = Programmatic + Paid Social + Paid Search for Postpaid + Broadband only.


WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(date AS DATE) AS date,
        TRY_CAST(spend AS DOUBLE) AS spend,
        NULLIF(TRIM(lob),'') AS lob,
        NULLIF(TRIM(DSP),'') AS dsp,
        NULLIF(TRIM(campaign_type),'') AS campaign_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(business_initiative),'') AS business_initiative,
        NULLIF(TRIM(budget_source),'') AS budget_source,
        NULLIF(TRIM(budget_product_line),'') AS budget_product_line,
        NULLIF(TRIM(program),'') AS program,
        NULLIF(TRIM(creative_type),'') AS creative_type
    FROM prd_dbi_analytics.improvado.pbi_programmatic_browsers_currentyr
)

SELECT 'LOB' AS dimension, COALESCE(lob,'<NULL>') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count, ROUND(SUM(spend),2) AS spend,
       MIN(date) AS min_date, MAX(date) AS max_date
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(lob,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'DSP / Platform', COALESCE(dsp,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(dsp,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Campaign Type', COALESCE(campaign_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(campaign_type,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Business Initiative', COALESCE(business_initiative,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(business_initiative,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Budget Source', COALESCE(budget_source,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(budget_source,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Budget Product Line', COALESCE(budget_product_line,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(budget_product_line,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Program', COALESCE(program,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(program,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Creative Type', COALESCE(creative_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(creative_type,'<NULL>')

ORDER BY dimension, spend DESC;

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(account_id),''),'<NULL>') AS account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campaign_count,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    ROUND(SUM(spend),2) AS spend,
    MIN(date) AS min_date,
    MAX(date) AS max_date
FROM prd_dbi_analytics.improvado.pbi_programmatic_browsers_currentyr
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(account_id),''),'<NULL>')
ORDER BY spend DESC;

SELECT
    UPPER(TRIM(lob)) AS lob,
    TRIM(DSP) AS dsp,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campaigns,
    ROUND(SUM(spend),2) AS spend,
    MIN(date) AS min_date,
    MAX(date) AS max_date
FROM prd_dbi_analytics.improvado.pbi_programmatic_browsers_currentyr
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(lob)) IN ('POSTPAID','CONSUMER POSTPAID','HSI','BROADBAND')
GROUP BY
    UPPER(TRIM(lob)),
    TRIM(DSP)
ORDER BY lob, spend DESC;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(date AS DATE) AS date,
        TRY_CAST(cost AS DOUBLE) AS spend,
        NULLIF(TRIM(lob),'') AS lob,
        NULLIF(TRIM(ad_platform),'') AS ad_platform,
        NULLIF(TRIM(campaign_type),'') AS campaign_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(advertising_channel_type),'') AS advertising_channel_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(advertising_channel_sub_type),'') AS advertising_channel_sub_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(bidding_strategy_type),'') AS bidding_strategy_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(serving_status),'') AS serving_status
    FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.sdi_tbl_sa360_gold_campaign_daily
)

SELECT 'LOB' AS dimension, COALESCE(lob,'<NULL>') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count, ROUND(SUM(spend),2) AS spend,
       MIN(date) AS min_date, MAX(date) AS max_date
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(lob,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Platform', COALESCE(ad_platform,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(ad_platform,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Campaign Type', COALESCE(campaign_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(campaign_type,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Advertising Channel Type', COALESCE(advertising_channel_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(advertising_channel_type,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Advertising Channel Sub-Type', COALESCE(advertising_channel_sub_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(advertising_channel_sub_type,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Bidding Strategy Type', COALESCE(bidding_strategy_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(bidding_strategy_type,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Serving Status', COALESCE(serving_status,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(serving_status,'<NULL>')

ORDER BY dimension, spend DESC;

SELECT
    UPPER(TRIM(lob)) AS lob,
    UPPER(TRIM(ad_platform)) AS ad_platform,
    COALESCE(campaign_type,'<NULL>') AS campaign_type,
    COALESCE(advertising_channel_type,'<NULL>') AS advertising_channel_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campaigns,
    ROUND(SUM(cost),2) AS spend,
    MIN(date) AS min_date,
    MAX(date) AS max_date
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.sdi_tbl_sa360_gold_campaign_daily
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(ad_platform)) IN (
    'GOOGLE','GOOGLE ADS','GOOGLE_ADS',
    'BING','MICROSOFT','MICROSOFT ADS','MICROSOFT_ADS'
)
AND UPPER(TRIM(lob)) IN (
    'POSTPAID','HSI','BROADBAND','FIBER'
)
GROUP BY
    UPPER(TRIM(lob)),
    UPPER(TRIM(ad_platform)),
    COALESCE(campaign_type,'<NULL>'),
    COALESCE(advertising_channel_type,'<NULL>')
ORDER BY lob, ad_platform, spend DESC;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(Date AS DATE) AS date,
        TRY_CAST(Spend AS DOUBLE) AS spend,
        NULLIF(TRIM(Agency),'') AS agency,
        NULLIF(TRIM(LOB),'') AS lob,
        NULLIF(TRIM(Channel_Name),'') AS channel_name,
        NULLIF(TRIM(Channel_Group_Name),'') AS channel_group,
        NULLIF(TRIM(Media_Tactic),'') AS media_tactic,
        NULLIF(TRIM(Buy_Type),'') AS buy_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(view_source),'') AS view_source
    FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Channel_Group_Name)) = 'PAID SOCIAL'
)

SELECT 'LOB' AS dimension, COALESCE(lob,'<NULL>') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count, ROUND(SUM(spend),2) AS spend,
       MIN(date) AS min_date, MAX(date) AS max_date
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(lob,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Agency', COALESCE(agency,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(agency,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Channel / Platform', COALESCE(channel_name,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(channel_name,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Media Tactic', COALESCE(media_tactic,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(media_tactic,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Buy Type', COALESCE(buy_type,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(buy_type,'<NULL>')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Source Feed', COALESCE(view_source,'<NULL>'),
       COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(spend),2), MIN(date), MAX(date)
FROM base
GROUP BY COALESCE(view_source,'<NULL>')

ORDER BY dimension, spend DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Channel_Name IN (
            'Paid Social - Facebook',
            'Paid Social - Instagram'
        ) THEN 'Meta'
        WHEN Channel_Name = 'Paid Social - Twitter'
        THEN 'X / Twitter'
        ELSE REPLACE(Channel_Name,'Paid Social - ','')
    END AS platform,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    ROUND(SUM(Spend),2) AS spend,
    MIN(Date) AS min_date,
    MAX(Date) AS max_date
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Channel_Group_Name)) = 'PAID SOCIAL'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY spend DESC;

SELECT
    Agency,
    LOB,
    Channel_Name,
    Account_ID,
    Account_Name,
    Campaign_ID,
    Campaign_Name,
    ROUND(SUM(Spend),2) AS spend,
    MIN(Date) AS min_date,
    MAX(Date) AS max_date
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Channel_Group_Name)) = 'PAID SOCIAL'
GROUP BY
    Agency,
    LOB,
    Channel_Name,
    Account_ID,
    Account_Name,
    Campaign_ID,
    Campaign_Name
ORDER BY spend DESC;

SELECT
    UPPER(TRIM(LOB)) AS lob,
    TRIM(Agency) AS agency,
    CASE
        WHEN Channel_Name IN (
            'Paid Social - Facebook',
            'Paid Social - Instagram'
        ) THEN 'Meta'
        WHEN Channel_Name = 'Paid Social - Twitter'
        THEN 'X / Twitter'
        ELSE REPLACE(Channel_Name,'Paid Social - ','')
    END AS platform,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Account_ID) AS accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Campaign_ID) AS campaigns,
    ROUND(SUM(Spend),2) AS spend,
    MIN(Date) AS min_date,
    MAX(Date) AS max_date
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Channel_Group_Name)) = 'PAID SOCIAL'
  AND UPPER(TRIM(Agency)) = 'INHOUSE'
  AND UPPER(TRIM(LOB)) IN ('POSTPAID','HSI','BROADBAND')
GROUP BY
    UPPER(TRIM(LOB)),
    TRIM(Agency),
    CASE
        WHEN Channel_Name IN (
            'Paid Social - Facebook',
            'Paid Social - Instagram'
        ) THEN 'Meta'
        WHEN Channel_Name = 'Paid Social - Twitter'
        THEN 'X / Twitter'
        ELSE REPLACE(Channel_Name,'Paid Social - ','')
    END
ORDER BY lob, spend DESC;
